# MDViewer

> Offline-first Markdown studio — edit, organize, preview, and optionally share via Cloudflare Workers. Private by default.

MDViewer is a client-side Markdown app (Vite + React) with an optional edge share API (Hono on Cloudflare Workers + R2). Core writing stays in the browser; no account required for local use.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install and run
- [Architecture](https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): SPA + worker layout
- [API](https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer/blob/main/docs/api.md): Worker endpoints (protocol 3)
- [Security](https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer/blob/main/docs/security.md): threat model and mitigations
- [Full agent brief](https://mdviewer.zamdev.dev/llms-full.txt): endpoints, manage token vs view password, MCP

## App

- [Source](https://github.com/zamdevio/mdviewer): GitHub

## Share links

Use path form only: SPA `https://mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share/<id>`, Worker raw `https://api.mdviewer.zamdev.dev/share/<id>`.

## Auth (do not conflate)

- **Manage token** — creator secret; required for upload / mutate / delete / rotate. Prefer `Authorization: Bearer`. Never put in the public URL.
- **View password** — optional disposable per-share secret for GET when `viewProtected`. Header `X-Share-Password` only. Never use as admin.
